name: ExceptionOS
tagline: Paste any message that needs a reply. See what they want, and get a draft in one step.
description:
Got an email from a recruiter, school, landlord, government office, or client and not sure how to answer? Paste it into ExceptionOS. In one step, Anna shows what they are asking for, any deadline as written, and what may be blocking progress, with each point quoted from the original message. Then it drafts a reply you can edit. Missing details become placeholders like [YOUR PORTFOLIO LINK], so nothing is invented.

Still waiting to hear back? Describe your last message and Anna drafts a short, polite follow-up. Copy it into your own email or chat app, record that you sent it, and choose a check-in date. The Attention today list shows what is due when you return. Later replies keep the earlier conversation, so you are not asked to resend what you already sent.

For bigger situations, start with a goal and Anna builds a short action plan that you can rebuild as things change. Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Everything is saved privately in your Anna account. ExceptionOS never sends messages or contacts anyone for you, and Anna only processes your content when you tick the consent box.

简体中文：粘贴任何需要回复的消息，Anna 帮你读懂对方的要求并起草回复；还没收到回复时，也能起草礼貌的跟进消息。
